skill.name: slack
skill.description: Automate Slack workspace navigation, searches, unread checks, and reporting through an authenticated browser session using agent-browser.
skill.summary: Use browser automation to inspect Slack messages, channels, unreads, and workspace activity.
skill.author: vercel-labs

security_audit.summary: Most static external-command hits are Markdown code fences or fixed agent-browser examples, not command injection. I confirmed a low hardcoded internal Slack permalink and privacy risks around Slack message sending, screenshots, snapshots, and user activity extraction. No prompt injection text was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Slack message actions lack an explicit approval guard
remediation.suggestion: Require final user confirmation before sending or editing Slack messages through browser automation.

remediation.issue: Sensitive Slack exports and screenshots can persist private content
remediation.suggestion: Default to summaries, redact personal data, and warn before saving screenshots, snapshots, or message text to disk.

remediation.issue: Monitoring workflows can be used for unauthorized surveillance
remediation.suggestion: Limit examples to authorized scopes and add consent guidance for DMs, private channels, reactions, and user activity reports.

remediation.issue: Documentation contains an internal Slack permalink
remediation.suggestion: Replace the Vercel Slack permalink with a neutral placeholder URL that does not expose workspace or message identifiers.

content.value_statement: Slack workspaces are hard to inspect manually when channels, DMs, and threads change quickly. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through browser automation for scoped Slack review and reporting.
actual_capabilities: Connect to an existing authenticated Slack browser session.
Open Slack web and inspect visible workspace content.
Find unread channels, DMs, Activity items, and thread context.
Search Slack messages with keywords and supported Slack filters.
Capture screenshots and snapshots for reports.
Parse visible channel, message, user, timestamp, and reaction data.
limitations: Requires an authenticated Slack browser session controlled by the user.
Element references change between sessions and require fresh snapshots.
Cannot bypass Slack permissions or access workspaces the user cannot view.
Screenshots and snapshots may contain sensitive workspace information.

use_cases.title: Triage Unread Slack Activity
use_cases.description: Review unread DMs, channels, Activity items, and threads before a work session.

use_cases.title: Prepare Channel Summaries
use_cases.description: Collect recent channel context, key topics, shared files, and action items for a scoped report.

use_cases.title: Search Historical Conversations
use_cases.description: Find messages by keyword, sender, channel, date range, and available Slack search filters.

prompt_templates.title: Check Unreads
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my Slack unreads. Report unread DMs, unread channels, and urgent threads. Ask before opening private conversations.

prompt_templates.title: Search a Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Slack for [term] in [channel]. Return message context, sender, time, and links when available. Do not save screenshots unless needed.

prompt_templates.title: Build Channel Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [channel] for [date range]. Summarize themes, action items, files, and unresolved questions. Redact sensitive personal details.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Workspace Activity
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a scoped Slack activity report for [workspace area]. Include search terms, evidence captured, privacy limits, and recommended follow-up actions.

output_examples.input: Check unread Slack activity before standup.
output: Activity shows four unread items across engineering and incidents.
Two DMs need review before standup.
No screenshots were saved because the summary was sufficient.

output_examples.input: Search for release blockers in the product channel.
output: Found three relevant messages from today.
The main blocker concerns staging deploy failures.
Recommended follow-up is to ask the release owner for the latest status.

output_examples.input: Prepare a weekly Slack summary for the design channel.
output: Top themes were onboarding flows, icon updates, and research notes.
Private personal comments were omitted from the summary.

best_practices: Confirm scope and consent before reading DMs or private channels.
Take a fresh snapshot before each click because element refs change.
Redact sensitive message content before sharing reports or screenshots.
anti_patterns: Do not automate posting messages without explicit final approval.
Do not export full conversations when a short summary is sufficient.
Do not rely on stale element refs from previous sessions.

faq.question: Does this skill use the Slack API?
faq.answer: No. It uses browser automation against a user-authenticated Slack web session.

faq.question: Does it need an active Slack session?
faq.answer: Yes. The browser must already be authenticated or able to open Slack for the user.

faq.question: Can it access private channels?
faq.answer: It can only inspect private channels that the current Slack user can already view.

faq.question: Can it send Slack messages?
faq.answer: The skill advertises message sending through browser actions. Users should require explicit confirmation before any post.

faq.question: What evidence can it capture?
faq.answer: It can capture visible snapshots, screenshots, message text, timestamps, channel names, and reaction details.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code in an agent-browser environment.
